operatingRules: No file the manifest binds is edited while shards run; report re-verifies all 52 hashes (review R2).
No interim outcome tallies are computed or read; progress is trial counts only. report runs once, after every shard has a complete terminal receipt (review R5).
Non-completion is a non-result, never a pass: cap exhaustion, a killed writer, a stale lock or a refused resume leaves the extension incomplete (review R3).

Technical recovery only for a shard that stopped without a terminal receipt: preserve its directory under a renamed path, record why, and rerun that shard from trial 0 with identical inputs. Rows are deterministic, so this repeats the same trials rather than drawing new ones. It is never used after any outcome has been read.

The results record states the endpoint-1 inflation under this stress (development estimate ~0.021: about 2x the nominal family alpha 0.01 and about 4x the 0.005 per-comparison level) alongside any pass (review R8).
